Hi Elena — looping in procurement ops details.

Thanks for the portal link. For Acme, the typical required items are:
- Completed vendor setup form (I've attached a Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf and Vendor_Setup_Form_Acme.xlsx)
- W-9 (Redwood_W-9.pdf attached)
- Primary banking details (we provide instructions but do not include full bank credentials in email; we can upload a vendor banking form into your portal)
- Contact for 1099/contracting: Neha Kapoor (we handle tax forms and contracting questions).

Our standard commercial paths:
- We accept both Purchase Orders (preferred for enterprise pilots) and card payments.
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 on PO by default; we can support card for one-time charges or pilot fees.
- If you'd like net-30 PO billing, please create the PO referencing deal ID RDW-5421 and send a copy to procurement@redwood.com. We'll generate invoice endpoints and provide our vendor ID for your portal.

Typical vendor setup timeline: 3-7 business days after all documents are uploaded and tax forms accepted. If your portal requires a specific filename format, we recommend: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_[company].pdf and Redwood_W-9.pdf.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf, Redwood_W-9.pdf, Vendor_Setup_Form_Acme.xlsx

Let me know if you need a scanned copy of our banking details or a secure upload instead of email.

Best,
